qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of auditing in the Bi Impl Scripting driver?
qa_pairs.output: Auditing in the Bi Impl Scripting driver is intended to track changes to sensitive information and to enable administrators to examine audit logs periodically to monitor those changes.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you monitor the operation of the Bi Impl Scripting driver using NetIQ Audit?
qa_pairs.output: To monitor the operation of the Bi Impl Scripting driver, use NetIQ Audit. Refer to the NetIQ Audit Documentation website at http://www.novell.com/documentation/novellaudit20/index.html for detailed instructions on configuring and viewing audit logs.

qa_pairs.instruction: Provide a brief summary of the auditing recommendations for the Bi Impl Scripting driver.
qa_pairs.output: The Auditing section for the Bi Impl Scripting driver advises tracking changes to sensitive information, regularly reviewing audit logs, and consulting the NetIQ Audit Documentation site for guidance on using NetIQ Audit to monitor driver activity.
